items.text: Elon Musk says Space X and Tesla are considering a merger
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，Musk表示SpaceX与特斯拉正在考虑合并，对特斯拉及未上市的SpaceX构成潜在重大重组催化。

items.author: Musk
items.text: EXCLUSIVE: Musk’s public endorsement of SpaceX-Tesla deal may throw a wrench in talks
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，Musk公开支持SpaceX与特斯拉合并，可能影响双方正在进行的合并谈判及相关股东预期。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Bloom Energy Q3 Preview: Analysts Expect Top Nancy Pelosi Holding to Grow Revenue 102% (CORRECTED)

items.author: Musk
items.text: Exclusive | Musk Ordered Starlink Slowdown That Blindsided Ukraine

items.author: 洪灏

items.author: Musk
items.text: Exclusive / Elon Musk makes $1 billion investment in Ellison’s Skydance
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，Musk向Ellison旗下的Skydance投资10亿美元，强化其对卫星通信及航天相关资产的布局。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，Musk与乌克兰的冲突加快了对Starlink替代通信方案的搜求，但市场可选择的同类供应商仍然有限。

items.text: 高盛：AI 開始買單計數
items.summary_cn: 据报道，高盛认为人工智能产业开始进入商业化兑现阶段，AI相关企业的收入前景受到关注。

items.text: Michael Burry Is Betting Against These 4 AI Stocks. Is He Right?

items.author: Trump
items.text: Iran is doing everything they can to drive up the price of Oil prior to the U.S. Midterm Election. They are even making up fake hits, mines, and everything else, because more Oil is coming through the Hormuz Strait now than it did even prior to the beginning of the Conflict. They continue to kill protestors, and anyone else that happens to be in their way. It is truly an Evil Regime, and I can only hope the American Public, and the World, understands how EVIL they are! 75,000 protestors lie dead in less than seven months. It is shocking how the World, and the Dumocrat Party, seem not to care.
items.summary_cn: 特朗普指责伊朗通过袭击等行动推高油价，但同时表示霍尔木兹海峡当前的石油流量高于冲突前，释放地缘风险与实际供应改善并存的信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: THE WALL STREET JOURNAL: “More Oil Is Now Coming Out of the Persian Gulf Than Before the Iran War.”
items.summary_cn: 特朗普引述《华尔街日报》称，伊朗战争期间波斯湾石油出口量反而高于战前，显示霍尔木兹海峡供应暂未明显收缩。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 美歐「分手」但同受高油價之苦！
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国与欧洲虽出现关系裂痕，但双方均受到高油价压力，能源成本可能继续影响欧美经济与通胀。
